meta.source: Snowflake Lockheed pull — current gates (size+lift+postings+specialized, composition growth, P95 emerging, ratio under-index, retention peer P10)
meta.attrition_definition: attrition = 12m sum employer-exit outflows / 12m avg monthly skill HC; hiring = 12m sum company-entry inflows / same avg HC
meta.retention_definition: target = max(company_attrition, P10 peer skill attrition); heads_saved = C * max(0, skill_attrition - target) * H
